system.description: This ritual requires the caster to sever her own thumb (costing a temporary Willpower Trait; the digit regenerates normally once the enlarged item is conjured). Thereafter, the thaumaturge may spend two or three temporary Mental Traits to make a summoned item from the Path of Conjuring double or triple its normal size, though the underlying power still limits what kind of object may be conjured. (Path of Conjuring)
